title: 小信号分析：直流工作点 + 动态电阻
statement: 直流电压源 V_s = 6 V 与小信号源 v_s(t) = 0.1cos(100t) V 串联，经 R = 1 Ω 给非线性电阻 N 供电，N 的特性为 i = v²（v ≥ 0；v < 0 时 i = 0）。
用小信号分析法求 N 的电压 v(t) = V_Q + v_1(t) 和电流 i(t) = I_Q + i_1(t)：先求直流工作点和动态电阻，再求小信号分量的振幅 V_1m、I_1m。

questions.explain: 令 v_s = 0：6 − v = v² → v² + v − 6 = 0 → V_Q = 2 V（−3 V 舍去）。
I_Q = V_Q² = 4 A；R 上压降 4 V，4 + 2 = 6 ✓。

questions.ask: Q 点的动态电阻 R_d = ?
小信号电压 v_1(t) 的振幅 V_1m = ?
小信号电流 i_1(t) 的振幅 I_1m = ?

choiceExplain: 对。总响应 = 直流工作点 + 小信号分量，小信号与 v_s 同相（电路是纯电阻性的）。
漏掉了直流工作点 V_Q。
小信号源的电压被 R 和 R_d 分压，N 上的小信号电压比 v_s 的振幅小。
V_Q 加振幅只是 v(t) 的最大值。
questions.explain: 小信号分析的结果是 v(t) ≈ V_Q + v_1(t)，只在 |v_1| 远小于工作点附近曲线明显弯曲的范围时才准确。

hints: 分两步：只留直流源求工作点；再只留小信号源，把 N 换成它在 Q 点的动态电阻。
工作点：6 − v = v²。动态电阻：R_d = 1/(di/dv)。
小信号等效电路是 v_s、R、R_d 串联的分压电路。
solution: **检查（两次精确求解作差）：** V_s 分别取 6.1 V 和 5.9 V 时，v² + v = V_s 的正根约为 2.0199 V 和 1.9799 V，差的一半 ≈ 0.020 V，与 V_1m 一致 ✓。

en.title: Small-signal analysis: DC operating point plus dynamic resistance
statement: A DC source V_s = 6 V in series with a small-signal source v_s(t) = 0.1cos(100t) V feeds the nonlinear resistor N through R = 1 Ω. N has i = v² (v ≥ 0; i = 0 for v < 0).

Use small-signal analysis to find N's voltage v(t) = V_Q + v_1(t) and current i(t) = I_Q + i_1(t): first the DC operating point and the dynamic resistance, then the amplitudes V_1m, I_1m of the small-signal parts.

questions.explain: Set v_s = 0: 6 − v = v² → v² + v − 6 = 0 → V_Q = 2 V (−3 V rejected).
I_Q = V_Q² = 4 A; R drops 4 V, 4 + 2 = 6 ✓.
di/dv = 2v = 4 S at v = 2 V, so R_d = 1/4 = 0.25 Ω.

questions.ask: Amplitude of the small-signal voltage v_1(t), V_1m = ?
questions.explain: Small-signal circuit: v_s drives R in series with R_d, V_1m = 0.1 × 0.25/(1 + 0.25) = 0.02 V.

questions.ask: Amplitude of the small-signal current i_1(t), I_1m = ?
The total voltage across N is:
choiceExplain: Right. Total response = DC operating point + small-signal part; the small signal is in phase with v_s (the circuit is purely resistive).
This drops the operating point V_Q.
The small-signal source is divided between R and R_d, so the small-signal voltage on N is smaller than the amplitude of v_s.
V_Q plus the amplitude is only the maximum of v(t).
questions.explain: Small-signal analysis gives v(t) ≈ V_Q + v_1(t); it is accurate only while v_1 stays within a range where the curve is nearly straight.

hints: Two steps: with only the DC source, find the operating point; with only the small-signal source, replace N by its dynamic resistance at Q.
Operating point: 6 − v = v². Dynamic resistance: R_d = 1/(di/dv).
The small-signal circuit is the divider v_s, R, R_d in series.
solution: **1. DC operating point (v_s = 0).** 6 − 1·i = v, i = v² → v² + v − 6 = 0 → **V_Q = 2 V, I_Q = 4 A** (v = −3 V violates v ≥ 0, rejected).
**2. Dynamic resistance.** di/dv at Q = 2V_Q = 4 S, **R_d = 0.25 Ω**.
**4. Total response.** v(t) ≈ 2 + 0.02cos(100t) V, i(t) ≈ 4 + 0.08cos(100t) A.
**Check (difference of two exact solutions):** with V_s = 6.1 V and 5.9 V the positive roots of v² + v = V_s are about 2.0199 V and 1.9799 V; half their difference ≈ 0.020 V, matching V_1m ✓.
